name: EXP-C1 · Day 0 · Link and delivered-rate gate
description: Paced illumination at 25/50/100/200 Hz against the experiment AP, to establish the rate the session can sustain. Abort criteria are pre-registered: delivered rate below floor, or illuminator silent.

steps.name: The gate everything else depends on

config.description: Doppler features are blocked by delivery jitter, not by rate: 0 of 500 windows passed the inter-arrival gate on the earlier captures. This exists to find that out on Day 0.
Associate, then pin the socket to that interface. An unpinned socket sends the sounding traffic over cellular, where no receiver can hear it.
Two minutes at 25 Hz. Pass condition: delivered rate at or above 100 Hz per link with inter-arrival CV below 0.5. Below the floor, stop and fix — every downstream feature reads this stream.
Two minutes at 50 Hz. Pass condition: delivered rate at or above 100 Hz per link with inter-arrival CV below 0.5. Below the floor, stop and fix — every downstream feature reads this stream.
Two minutes at 100 Hz. Pass condition: delivered rate at or above 100 Hz per link with inter-arrival CV below 0.5. Below the floor, stop and fix — every downstream feature reads this stream.
Two minutes at 200 Hz. Pass condition: delivered rate at or above 100 Hz per link with inter-arrival CV below 0.5. Below the floor, stop and fix — every downstream feature reads this stream.
The rung where delivery or CV breaks is the session's ceiling. Configure the staircase below it.
